tagline: A wide stance pull with the hips close to the bar.

coaching.summary: Take a wide stance with toes turned out, grip the bar inside your knees, then push the floor apart and stand up tall.
cues: Stand wide with the toes out and the shins close to the bar.
Push the knees out over the toes and pull the slack out before the bar moves.
Drive the floor apart and keep the bar close all the way to lockout.
